Likes to brag. |id = SADAN_1, MASTER_SADAN_1 }} '''Sadan''' is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor VI]], and as a character appearing in the [[Journal Entry|dungeon journals]] [[Journal Entry#Aftermath|Aftermath]] and [[Journal Entry#The Eye|The Eye]]. His status is the '''Necromancer Lord'''. == Collection == Killing Sadan increases the Sadan collection. {{CollectionTable|Sadan}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == Sadan's boss fight takes place in a large, tall hall with two wings, one of which the players emerge from. When the players enter, 16 dormant {{MobSprite|Terracotta}}s stand along the hall. {{MobSprite|Sleeping Golem}}s reside in the main chamber of Sadan's room, and attacking them will turn them into {{MobSprite|Woke Golem}}. Above are four cages, each with a Giant inside it, and a large section beneath containing a larger Giant. === Phase 1 === During Sadan's first phase, he reanimates several {{MobSprite|Terracotta}}s that will start to damage the player, dealing melee and ranged damage. These will attack the players for {{Green|2}} minutes, displayed by a timer labeled '''Sadan's Interest Meter''': killing a {{MobSprite|Terracotta}} will reduce this timer by {{Green|1}} second. Once killed, {{MobSprite|Terracotta}}s will turn into a skull on the ground. After {{Green|10}} seconds, they will respawn where they died and attack the player until '''Sadan's Interest Meter''' is depleted. === Phase 2 === Four different giants, being {{MobSprite|The Diamond Giant}}, {{MobSprite|L.A.S.R.}}, {{MobSprite|Bigfoot}}, and the {{MobSprite|Jolly Pink Giant}}, will drop from cages in the sky to attack. Each giant has a different attack and has a chance to appear as [[The Watcher|Watcher Undeads]] in [[The Catacombs - Floor VII]]. * {{MobSprite|The Diamond Giant}} will damage players with the '''Sword of 1,000 Truths'''. * {{MobSprite|L.A.S.R.}} will fire at players with a the '''L.A.S.R Eye Beam''', dealing increased damage over time. * {{MobSprite|Bigfoot}} will use '''Stomp''' on players, dealing high amounts of damage. * The {{MobSprite|Jolly Pink Giant}} will use '''Boulder Toss''' on players, throwing a large boulder at players and dealing large damage. === Phase 3 === A cutscene will play where Sadan will merge with his "Ultimate Corpse", {{MobSprite|The Giant One|nolink=yes}}, and become a Giant himself. A hole will open in the center of the hall, and a hook will appear to lift the Giant out. Falling into the hole instantly kills the player who fell in and all [[Tank]]s in the team (because of [[Tank]]s' passive ability Diversion). After this cutscene, the hole closes, allowing players to safely walk over it again. In the form of The Giant One, Sadan has all the perks of the previous Giants combined. Players win the fight by defeating Sadan in this Giant form. Unlike the previous giants, The Giant One does not have [[Knockback]] immunity. === Summoned Mobs === Below are a list of [[Mobs]] that appear during the fight. In [[Master Mode]], the four giants are replaced with four {{MobSprite|Mutant Giant}}s. {{Mob Table|show_behavior = yes| {{Mob Table Row|Terracotta|behavior = Attacks the player with the melee and ranged attacks of the {{Item|Flower of Truth}}. The ranged attack can pass through walls. It revives itself after a while on Phase 1.}} {{Mob Table Row|Golem|name = Sleeping/Woke Golem |behavior = This Golem awakes once it is attacked, after which it quickly runs towards nearby players to attack them.}} {{Mob Table Row|Bigfoot|behavior = Can stomp to deal very heavy damage. The damage depends how close the player is to the mob when the attack is performed and how high the mob jumped.}} {{Mob Table Row|L.A.S.R.|behavior = Shoots lasers that never miss at players.}} {{Mob Table Row|Jolly Pink Giant|behavior = Can toss boulders. Damage dealt depends on how close the player is to the center of the impact.}} {{Mob Table Row|The Diamond Giant|behavior = Can use the Sword of 10,000 Truths to deal heavy damage. The mob can also throw the sword to deal even more damage.}} {{Mob Table Row|Mutant Giant|behavior = Has two random abilities of the previous four giants.}} }} === Master Mode Changes === * Instead of the normal giants, {{MobSprite|Mutant Giant}}s will spawn with {{Stat|Health|600,000,000}}, and can use all two randomly selected abilities of the other giants at once. * After the cutscene, the 4 {{MobSprite|Mutant Giant}}s respawn at the 4 pillars together with Sadan to fight the players. == Drops == Killing Sadan directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 611-1,097 |coins = 1,527-2,742 |combat_xp = 4,582-8,227 |orbs = 1,833-3,291 }} Defeating him will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor VI/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor VI/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 611 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor VI]] |health = 40,000,000 |damage = 30,960 |coins = 1,527 |combat_xp = 4,582 |orbs = 1,833 |id = SADAN_1 |level2 = 1,097 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor VI|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor VI]] |health2 = 600,000,000 |damage2 = 720,000 |coins2 = 2,742 |combat_xp2 = 8,227 |orbs2 = 3,291 |id2 = MASTER_SADAN_1 }} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Boss Fight Start |{{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] &cSadan&f: So you made it all the way here... THIS IS IMPOSSIBLE!! &4[BOSS] &cSadan&f: FATHER, FORGIVE ME!!!}} |} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Sadan}} == Lore == * In [[Time Systems#AE|1531 AE]], after zombies began leaving [[The Catacombs|{{red|The Catacombs}}]] a human king sent an expedition with 3 mages to investigate. Mages were the Royal Inscriptionist, who kept a four-volume journal about the expedition until his death, [[Solomon]] and [[Sadan]]. * During the expedition, Sadan noticed [[The Watcher|an Eye]] looking directly at him, but no one else seemed to notice it, so he kept it to himself, since it didn't seem hostile. It appeared 3 times throughout the first and second floor, then disappeared. However, on the third floor, he felt a different sensation: he sensed something coming even before more talented [[Solomon]]. Sadan managed to escape the massacre caused by [[Necron|the Wither]] that appeared and killed [[General Dan]], then he felt the familiar sensation of being watched. He pulled out his sword, asking "What do you want from me?", [[The Watcher]] came out of the shadows and questioned him "What are you? Why are you following me?" "Special." the loud noise echoed in Sadan's head. "I’m special? What do you mean?" "Your mind… Hard to read." "Read… My mind?" "Your name." "What, why do you want to know?" "Your parents, who are they?" "I… I never knew them, why are you asking this?!" It asked for [his] name again. As it got closer, [he] could feel its presence intensify. "GET OUT OF MY HEAD, I’LL KILL YOU!" Sadan felt weakened, and collapsed on the ground. "So your name is Sadan, I see..." *Some time after his interaction with the Watcher, he became Necromancer Lord and guarded the Sixth floor of Catacombs. He learned that his parents were powerful in Necromancy, which is why Watcher was interested in him. *In 1532 AE, he learned that his father was still alive, if you could call it that. He was a member of [[Necron]]'s Wither Army - [[Storm]]. But his father didn't care for him, which made Sadan angry, and he swore that he would develop a technique to surpass even a Wither with his own abilities. *According to [[Mort]]'s description of Sadan, he succeeded, but it is unclear if the Wither in question was [[Storm]], his unknown professor or a different Wither entirely. == Trivia == * The boss appears to have an egotistical and self-centered nature, possibly caused by his father, [[Storm]] not caring about him and him choosing power rather than humanity. He shares his ego with his father, and they both seem to make up with each other when faced with death, as their last words reference each other. * This boss used to be a part of the Expedition team as one of at least 3 mages. Because his family was skilled in Necromancy, [[The Watcher]] saw his potential to be a servant of Necron. In the journal Aftermath, it is said that Solomon (One of the mages on the Expedition team) was also pulled aside by Necron and executed by Storm for him to gain immense power his third wither head. * The sword that the Diamond Giant wields is actually called Diamante (which translates to "Diamond" in Spanish and Italian). * His head has the same texture as the [[The Professor|Professor's]], except recoloured. * The Terracotta mob is a reference to the terracotta army in the Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum in China. * The name Sadan could be a reference to the devil, Satan and his number 666. This could also explain why Sadan is the floor 6 boss in the Catacombs. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jul 22|version=none|Changed '''Terracotta''' [[Bestiary]] Bracket from {{Green|1}} to {{Green|2}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|611-1,097}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|1,527-2,742}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|100-200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,833-3,291}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|4,000-6,000}} to {{Dark Aqua|4,582-8,227}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.9.4|[[File:Sadan.png|26px]] Added '''Sadan'''.}} {{History|2023/September 12|Significantly sped up the Giant One's animation.}} {{History|0.27|Changed '''Terracotta''' [[Bestiary]] Bracket from {{Green|1}} to {{Green|2}}.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|611-1,097}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|1,527-2,742}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|100-200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,833-3,291}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|4,000-6,000}} to {{Dark Aqua|4,582-8,227}}.}} }}
